note: The one data file Core reads for the world's scale (Code/Ascend.Core/WorldScale.cs). It restates figures that already exist and the validator keeps them equal: unitKm, cellKm and mapUnits mirror physical_map.json grid; builtTileKm is the --tile-km default of Tools/blender/build_world_sectors.py. Settled 2026-11-07 (Canon section 6 WF9): 1 map unit = 1 km, 10.24 km terrain tiles, origin at the north-west corner. Docs: 12_Systems/world_graph.md.
terrainTileKmStatus: decided 2026-11-07 by Claude under delegated creative control (Canon section 6 WF9); the user may overrule. 10.24 km makes 513-sample 20 m Unity tiles (terrain_unity_import.md). Tiles built today are builtTileKm and are rebuilt at 10.24 km when terrain streaming is built.

origin.status: decided 2026-11-07 by Claude under delegated creative control (Canon section 6 WF9); the user may overrule. Unity metre (0, 0) is the map's north-west corner, as built and tested. Rebasing to Brindlewick stays possible by changing this one value (the tests assume the corner, so it would be a deliberate change).
